known: Benoist and Poonen–Slavov give exact modern depth/equidimensionality bounds; the fixed-divisor blowup obstruction is elementary.

title: Reconstruct higher abelian mapping groupoids
known: Strict abelian n-categories yield chain complexes after globularity; general Picard groupoids retain a self-commutor; K-theory needs exact/enhanced data.
residual: The manuscript does not specify weak higher morphisms or the mapping-object truncation.
first_step: Work out n=2 with explicit complexes and a nonzero Ext1 example, then compare the chosen weak-morphism model with truncated RHom and the Picard epsilon invariant.
would_establish: The manuscript does not specify weak higher morphisms or the mapping-object truncation.

title: Replace noetherian fppf point tests by an exact local model
what_it_would_establish: A concise explanation of why noetherian tests miss nilpotents and how a genuinely fppf-local test ring repairs that failure.
known: Schröer’s noetherian classification and the dual-number sieve give a complete negative answer to the noetherian proposal. Gabber–Kelly’s table deliberately treats other topologies under its stated hypotheses.
residual: A useful follow-up can work through one nonnoetherian fppf-local construction; it should not promise a new classification of all fppf points.
first_step: Start with the dual numbers over an algebraically closed field, identify the noncovering reduced sieve, and follow the exact construction of a local object that detects it in the opened fppf source.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.
would_establish: A useful follow-up can work through one nonnoetherian fppf-local construction; it should not promise a new classification of all fppf points.

title: A worked inverse image of stacks and relative classifier

residual: The final notation for a stack of slice topoi is not sufficiently developed to identify a theorem. That endpoint must remain separate from the valid structure-stack construction.
first_step: Choose a finite group action or a two-object algebraic structure on a simple site, write the actual descent groupoids, and compute the universal property of the relative 2-pullback.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.
would_establish: The final notation for a stack of slice topoi is not sufficiently developed to identify a theorem. That endpoint must remain separate from the valid structure-stack construction.

title: Internal component bounds and the torsor of decompositions
what_it_would_establish: A precise internal statement relating a finite Boolean idempotent algebra, a bound on connected factors, and the torsor of ordered decompositions.
known: The ordinary ring statement is proved, including the necessary finiteness of the Boolean algebra. Exact component rank is not preserved by arbitrary filtered colimits. Once a torsor is given, its pullback property follows from finite limits and epimorphisms.
residual: The construction of the sheaf of all decompositions through the proposed largest locus has not been shown to commute with inverse image. A chosen decomposition and an unstructured exact-rank property have different morphisms.
first_step: Write the rank-at-most-n condition as an explicit coherent formula, construct ordered decompositions for n=2 in a sheaf topos, and compare the result with the source’s e-prime-n before considering arbitrary base change.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.
would_establish: The construction of the sheaf of all decompositions through the proposed largest locus has not been shown to commute with inverse image. A chosen decomposition and an unstructured exact-rank property have different morphisms.

title: Formal smoothness and formal étaleness with fixed hypotheses
what_it_would_establish: A logical and categorical formulation of the relative algebra properties that the source groups together, with each lifting quantifier and finiteness assumption explicit.
known: The opened Stacks results identify formal smoothness, formal étaleness, finite presentation, and the ordinary local criteria. The source’s general list does not itself establish a geometric classifier for every property.
residual: Quantification over arbitrary square-zero extensions is not automatically a geometric formula. The correct restricted presentation must be fixed before claiming inverse-image stability.
first_step: Fix a finitely presented A-algebra B. Write its square-zero lifting condition in terms of a finite presentation and compare that condition with the exact smooth/étale criteria before changing the base to an arbitrary topos.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.
would_establish: Quantification over arbitrary square-zero extensions is not automatically a geometric formula. The correct restricted presentation must be fixed before claiming inverse-image stability.
